profile.address: Elk Grove Village, IL (EdgeConneX Chicago campus)
profile.reading: EdgeConneX CHI02 sits in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, on the same campus as the earlier CHI01 building. Per the operator own Chicago market page, CHI02 Phase 1 provides 282,000 square feet of raised-floor space for tenants with 7 megawatts of N plus 1 total capacity for that phase, though no overall building square footage or opening year distinct from the raised-floor figure is disclosed, and no tenant is named for CHI02 specifically. The same Chicago campus includes CHI03, described on the same page at 22.4 megawatts, and CHI04, announced in an August 2025 press release as a more than 30 megawatt facility built for AI-compute customer Lambda, with 23 megawatts single-tenant and service targeted for 2026, a rare instance of EdgeConneX publicly naming a specific anchor tenant. Those are separate buildings from CHI02 and should not be conflated with it. EdgeConneX is a US-based edge and build-to-suit data center operator founded in 2009 and headquartered in Herndon, Virginia, with regional headquarters in Amsterdam and Singapore, acquired by EQT Infrastructure in 2020 with Sixth Street also holding a board seat, though exact ownership percentages are not disclosed publicly. EdgeConneX describes its footprint today as more than 90 data centers across more than 60 markets in over 20 countries on four continents, and it operates a joint venture called AdaniConneX in India alongside a strategic investment in the China-based operator Chayora. The company model centers on build-to-suit and build-to-density facilities serving cloud, AI and high-performance computing, content-delivery, and network or ISP tenants. Elk Grove Village sits in the O Hare International Airport industrial corridor northwest of downtown Chicago, a cluster that has drawn multiple operators given its fiber connectivity, airport proximity, and interstate access, which helps explain why EdgeConneX built four successive numbered facilities, CHI01 through CHI04, on essentially one campus rather than spreading its Chicago-area presence across separate sites.
profile.research_note: 282,000 sqft raised floor and 7 MW N+1 for CHI02 Phase 1 confirmed via EdgeConneX own Chicago market page. CHI03/CHI04 context included to distinguish this record from those separate buildings on the same campus. No tenant named for CHI02 itself.

reading.body:
EdgeConneX CHI02 is one building on a four-building Chicago campus in Elk Grove Village, in the O'Hare corridor northwest of downtown. The facility provides 7 megawatts of N+1 IT capacity across 282,000 square feet of raised floor in its Phase 1, with no opening date or overall building footprint published. At typical AI training density of 40 kilowatts per rack, this 7 megawatt phase translates to roughly 175 racks; the operator has not named any tenant for CHI02 itself.

In Illinois, CHI02 ranks seventh by published capacity among the 44 mapped facilities in the state and seventh among the 6 facilities with published megawatt figures. Those six facilities together account for 236 megawatts of published capacity. The state's ranking and the tight clustering of EdgeConneX buildings on one campus reflect the Elk Grove Village industrial corridor's appeal for fiber, airport access, and interstate connectivity, which has drawn multiple operators to the region.

CHI02 holds HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2 Type 2, and ISO 27001 certifications, qualifying it to host regulated workloads in healthcare, payments, and finance. The same campus includes CHI03 at 22.4 megawatts and CHI04, a dedicated 30-plus-megawatt AI facility anchored by Lambda and targeted for 2026, though those are separate buildings and should not be conflated with CHI02's capacity or timeline.
